defensiveAbilities.name: Frost Susceptibility
defensiveAbilities.description: Whenever the counteflora takes cold damage, it takes a -10-foot circumstance penalty to Speed for 1 round.

defensiveAbilities.name: Tighten Bracts
defensiveAbilities.description: The counteflora stiffens the specialized leaves around its flower head, protecting its sensitive seedpods. While its bracts are tightened, a counteflora gains a +2 circumstance bonus to AC and can use its head Strike and Furious Swing abilities, but it cannot use its Black Seed Cloud ability and it loses its sense of sight (so it must rely on its imprecise tremorsense when targeting other creatures). The counteflora can't use its head Strike of Furious Swing ability unless its bracts are tightened. The counteflora can loosen its bracts as a free action. Against plants and fungi, the seeds burrow into the creatures' flesh rather than infiltrate their lungs.

offensiveAbilities.name: Black Seed Cloud
offensiveAbilities.description:
Requirements the Counteflora's bracts are not tightened.

The counteflora releases a cloud of black seedpods in a 15-foot-radius emanation. Non-counteflora creatures in the area must succeed at a Fortitude save or breathe in the toxic seeds. (Against plants and fungi, the seeds burrow into the creatures' flesh rather than infiltrate their lungs.)

offensiveAbilities.name: Counteflora Toxin
offensiveAbilities.description:
Saving Throw DC 30 Fortitude Saving Throw (DC 32 Fortitude Saving Throw for plants and fungi)

Maximum Duration 6 rounds

Stage 1 4d6 Poison Damage damage and Enfeebled 1 (1 round)

Stage 2 6d6 Poison Damage damage, enfeebled 1, and Fascinated (1 round)

offensiveAbilities.name: Furious Swing
offensiveAbilities.description:
Requirements The counteflora's bracts are tightened

Effect The counteflora makes up to four headbutt Strikes (see Flower Headbutt), each against a different creature within reach.
